contract.authoritative_inputs: The authenticated request fields, admitted project corpus, immutable evidence references and original-source locations; the deck uses the repository architecture and product contracts named in its footers.
contract.authoritative_output: One exact discrepancy assessment with explicit governed status, selectable cited evidence, highlighted original cells where available, and an authenticated human reconciliation decision; the media output is a captioned explanatory rehearsal, not procurement authority.
contract.scope_as_of: Reconciliation scope is exactly tenant, project, site, and item. The server owns effective_at. A choice can affect only evaluations at or after that time; historical assessments and decisions are unchanged.
contract.governing_policy: Models may interpret questions; deterministic domain services and governing-claim policy own quantities, conflict, absence and assessment status. An authenticated human may choose one of exactly two eligible displayed requirement claims, keep the exact scope unresolved, or flag the assessment for correction. No choice triggers procurement action.
contract.evidence_retained: Every cited reference remains selectable; row sources retain headers, cells and highlighted columns; authority sources retain complete structured detail; losing and conflicting assertions remain auditable. Recording attempts and credential-free reports are retained separately.
contract.typed_failures: Empty evidence renders an explicit message; source HTTP failures preserve the prior visible source; unavailable model execution returns model_unavailable without a brief; stale digest, changed candidate set, ineligible or foreign claim, malformed outcome, authentication, and scope failures remain distinct closed boundaries with no reconciliation write.

scenarios.rationale: Empty evidence is explicit, and missing observations remain unknown rather than zero.
Exactly two conflicting eligible requirements may be resolved; three or more remain unresolved, and both winning and losing assertions stay retained.
Exact tenant, project, site, and item isolation is enforced, and a server-timed choice never changes an earlier as-of result.
This slice changes evidence presentation and recording, not quantity arithmetic or numeric policy.
Malformed public requests remain typed failures, and recording refuses incomplete banners or existing evidence directories.
The browser caller, native deck structure, rendered slides, captions and WebM are directly verified public artifacts.
The artifacts explicitly deny live inference for the publishable fixture, purchasing authority, deployment and implemented non-procurement verticals.
